strings.zh: 和你的对战太有意思了！{NEWLINE}一定要和我交换一下{CLEAR}电话号码！{SCROLL}请一定要和我交换！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: It was fun battling you!{NEWLINE}I’d love to trade phone numbers with{CLEAR}you, please?{CLEAR}Come on, let’s trade numbers! {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 谢谢你！{NEWLINE}下次我们再来比一场吧！{SCROLL}等你准备好了再打电话来吧。
strings.en: Thanks! Let’s have another battle{NEWLINE}again sometime!{SCROLL}Just give me a call when you’re ready.

strings.zh: 嗯！{SCROLL}难道是因为我太年轻,{NEWLINE}还不够格以成为你的对手吗！
strings.en: Hmph!{SCROLL}Is it because I’m too young to be{NEWLINE}worthy of being your opponent?!

strings.zh: 请一定要和我交换{NEWLINE}电话号码啊！{SCROLL}请务必和我交换！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Please trade phone numbers with me!{NEWLINE}Please, I’m begging you! {VAR:0200:0}
strings.notes: US 0682/4 | RV072: addition: removed 'I'd do anything' (D-2016)

strings.zh: 这个就是光之石！{SCROLL}你就不要客气了,{NEWLINE}赶紧收下吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Oh yeah.{NEWLINE}This is a Shiny Stone.{SCROLL}It’s all right, don’t be shy! You can{NEWLINE}have it. Go ahead!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 哎？这感觉⋯⋯{NEWLINE}莫非你就在我附近？{SCROLL}要是在附近的话,{NEWLINE}直接找我当面说好了啊！
strings.en: Huh? There’s something odd about your{NEWLINE}voice... Don’t tell me... You’re{CLEAR}standing nearby, aren’t you?{SCROLL}If you’ve already gotten this close,{NEWLINE}why not come talk in person?

strings.zh: 喂,是我,{NEWLINE}羽毛球啊⋯⋯{SCROLL}我的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}现在锻炼得很强了哦！{SCROLL}就在最近的一场对战中,{NEWLINE}仅仅用了两秒就把{CLEAR}{VAR:0100:11}给打倒了！{SCROLL}⋯⋯不对两秒的话{NEWLINE}有点吹过头了,{SCROLL}其实是用了５分３７秒。
strings.en: I’m still a featherweight, as usual...{SCROLL}My constant companion, {VAR:0100:10},{NEWLINE}is training hard!{SCROLL}It even knocked out a {VAR:0100:11} in{NEWLINE}under two seconds in a recent battle!{SCROLL}OK, OK, two seconds is a bit of an{NEWLINE}exaggeration... It was actually five{CLEAR}minutes and 37 seconds...

strings.zh: 我的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}已经变得很强了！{SCROLL}不过{NEWLINE}还是被{VAR:0100:11}逃了,{CLEAR}就差那么一丁点⋯⋯{SCROLL}那是{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:10}的错吗？{SCROLL}你说是我的责任？{SCROLL}或许你说得在理！
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10} has{NEWLINE}gotten pretty strong!{SCROLL}Well, it’s gotten strong, but this{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11} it was battling ran{CLEAR}away before the fight was over...{SCROLL}That was {VAR:0100:10}’s fault, right?{SCROLL}It was my fault?{SCROLL}I guess that’s a possibility!

strings.zh: 前段时间我走在路上,{NEWLINE}正在思考问题。{SCROLL}突然间{VAR:0100:11}{NEWLINE}跳了出来！{SCROLL}把我吓了一大跳,{NEWLINE}想都没想就跑了！{SCROLL}回头一想,我和朋友都约好了{NEWLINE}要交换{VAR:0100:11}的,{CLEAR}我还找了它很久,{SCROLL}真是好可惜啊。
strings.en: The other day I was walking{NEWLINE}along, thinking about something.{SCROLL}Suddenly a {VAR:0100:11} jumped out!{SCROLL}It scared me so much, I{NEWLINE}ran off without thinking!{SCROLL}Then I remembered I’d promised to{NEWLINE}trade a {VAR:0100:11} with a friend, and{CLEAR}I’d been looking for one for ages.{SCROLL}What a waste...

strings.zh: 你在哪？我还是和平时一样{NEWLINE}在{VAR:0104:3}。{SCROLL}要是你乐意的话,{NEWLINE}再和我来场对战怎么样？{CLEAR}行？那我等你！
strings.en: Where are you now? I’m always on{NEWLINE}{VAR:0104:3} myself.{SCROLL}What do you think about battling with me{NEWLINE}again? Sounds like a good idea?{CLEAR}I’ll be waiting!

strings.zh: 阿、阿嚏！{SCROLL}阿嚏！{SCROLL}我的鸟精灵们{NEWLINE}突然间都拍起了翅膀,{CLEAR}他们翅膀上的绒毛{CLEAR}都散落在周围,{CLEAR}弄得我鼻⋯⋯鼻子里面{CLEAR}痒痒的⋯⋯{SCROLL}阿嚏！！
strings.en: Ah... Ah... Achoo! Achoo!{SCROLL}My bird Pokémon suddenly started{NEWLINE}flapping their wings, and the fluff from{CLEAR}their wings is floating all around, so my{CLEAR}n-nose is all itchy...{SCROLL}Achoooo!
strings.notes: US 0682/12 | RV072: meaning: 绒毛 = down/fluff; removed 'it's nothing' (D-2016)

strings.zh: 最近我的精灵上{NEWLINE}多了些什么东西,{SCROLL}我还在想是什么呢,仔细一看{NEWLINE}居然！居然是光之石！{CLEAR}你也吓一跳吧？{SCROLL}不过光之石到底是什么东西？{SCROLL}我对这东西一无所知,{NEWLINE}拿在我手上也没什么用,{CLEAR}还是送给你吧！{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}等你来拿吧！
strings.en: Recently there was something on my{NEWLINE}Pokémon.{SCROLL}I wondered what it was, and when I{NEWLINE}looked closely... It was...{SCROLL}It was a Shiny Stone! Surprised, aren’t{NEWLINE}you? But what even is a Shiny Stone?{SCROLL}I don’t know a thing about it, and it’s{NEWLINE}no use to me, so I’ll give it to you!{SCROLL}I’m on {VAR:0104:3}. Come get it!
strings.notes: US 0682/13 | RV072: addition: removed invented mouth/pulling (D-2016)

strings.zh: 你想要光之石吗？{NEWLINE}那就快来{VAR:0104:3},{CLEAR}我等你！
strings.en: You want a Shiny Stone, right?{NEWLINE}I’m on {VAR:0104:3}. Come get it!
